'''Tuwezz Vol''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He was a [[Hunting/Legends|hunter]] who resided in [[Rodian Hunting Grounds|Etyyy]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].
